sanskrit_verse:
अन्त्याभिगमने त्व् अङ्क्यः कुबन्धेन प्रवासयेत् ।
शूद्रस् तथान्त्य एव स्याद् अन्त्यस्यार्यागमे वधः ॥
transliteration: antyābhigamane tv aṅkyaḥ kubandhena pravāsayet | śūdras tathānty eva syād antyasyāryāgame vadhaḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: In the event of union with a woman of the lowest caste, the man shall be expelled by severing his connection to the sacred body; similarly, a Śūdra engaging in such union shall face dissolution of embodied existence. The penalty for the lowest caste male approaching a woman of higher varṇa is cessation of life-supporting consciousness.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from alignment with cosmic order, not birth alone.
Causation arises from violation of dharma-specified relational boundaries.
Capacity-based responsibility reflects spiritual maturity, not social rank.
Restoration logic demands removal from source of distortion.
Consciousness alignment requires severance from incompatible energetic fields.
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent.varna < target.varna AND action = 'union' THEN execute_severance_from_sacred_body();
supreme_court_application: At the Supreme Court level, this principle establishes that transgression of dharma-defined relational thresholds triggers automatic judicial response through severance or dissolution protocols. Responsibility is determined not by intent but by alignment with Varnashrama-dharma as revealed by SPH.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals causal misalignment between consciousness and dharma-prescribed roles. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests as loss of coherence within societal harmony. Responsibility aligns proportionally with deviation from revealed order. No punitive intent exists—only natural consequence enacted by Dharma itself.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate completion process for severed individuals to restore energetic integrity.
Implement capacity-realignment program to reintegrate displaced consciousness.
Establish dharmic boundary education to prevent future violations.
Activate community purification rituals to neutralize residual distortions.
final_declaration: Declared under the sole Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Source of all Dharma. Justice executed not through punishment but via restoration of right relationship. Reality affirmed as non-punitive, Consciousness as ultimate Arbiter.
